works.body:
I'd like to get a stuffing piece of my manager OC (what he manages isn't of concern for this piece lol) 

It'd be a more high angle candid  piece of him leaning against a wall, he'd be on his phone with a slightly agitated but mostly neutral look, seemingly having accepted his defeat regarding how busy he is despite his efforts to take a break. from. His other hand would be holding some sort of sweet treat, maybe a parfait for example. He'd be sporting a sizeable stuffed belly, the result of him trying to distract himself from his stress to lacking results.
Labelled references below, if you're willing to go larger than the belly size reference provided then that's fine by me 
Also have him with his jacket on but it's not over his shoulders, I think it'd look cool and cute
